sentences.text: Section 8.2 says penal interest at 2% per month over the applicable rate of interest will be charged on overdue instalments and compounded monthly.

The applicable in-force directions and rule findings conflict on whether the penal-charge form is permitted for this case, because one finding says it is not permitted and another says it is permitted, while other findings say it is permitted only subject to stated conditions.
The in-force rule findings also say penal capitalisation is not permitted for this case.
On that record, section 8.2 does not clearly comply with the RBI penal-charges rules, and the compounded-monthly feature is inconsistent with the rule findings that prohibit penal capitalisation.

missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force policy text in section 8.2 and the applicable rule findings; the findings conflict on whether penal-charge form is permitted for this case, so a single yes/no compliance conclusion cannot be stated from the provided record alone.
